name: time-announcer
description: Announce the current time, time zone and elapsed time to the ZCode agent at the right moments.

plugins.name: time-announcer
plugins.description: 在恰当的时刻向 agent 注入当前时间、时区和经过时长，避免 agent 估计时间出错；行为对齐 deepseek-harness 的 time-context 插件。

description_i18n.en: Announces the current time, time zone and elapsed time to the agent at the right moments, so it does not have to estimate the clock. Behaviour follows deepseek-harness time-context.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在恰当的时刻向 agent 注入当前时间、时区和经过时长，避免 agent 估计时间出错；行为对齐 deepseek-harness 的 time-context 插件。
